bibliographic.title: The Necrotics: Jace
bibliographic.author: plutoerebus
bibliographic.description:
Work is hell for Jace in this gay zombie horror interactive fiction microgame. This a prequel to The Necrotics: Troy, set in an American shopping mall in the 80's. This is a very short (500 word) entry for Neo-Twiny Jam 2026.

Content Warning:

Intended for mature audiences: language, violence, blood, gore, implied homophobia
